mechanics.title: Depth tint
mechanics.description: Water is tinted between a shallow tint and a deep tint over a configurable depth range, with smoothing across drop-offs.

mechanics.title: Underwater fog
mechanics.description: Optional fog that thickens with depth when submerged; disabled by default.

qol: Easier to judge ocean depth when sailing or swimming.
getting_started: Works automatically; adjust via Mod Menu or config/bathymetry.json5.
editor_notes: Some shaders override water color and ignore the mod. Requires MossyLib.
name: Bathymetry
summary: Tints water according to its depth, so shallows look normal and deep water gets darker, instead of puddles and oceans looking identical. Biome water colors are preserved. Optional depth-based underwater fog.
